patterns.note: Sections are full-bleed with generous vertical padding, predominantly using a dark background, and often feature content split into a prominent left-aligned heading and a right-aligned descriptive text block.

A strong typographic hierarchy is established with very large, bold, sans-serif headings for impact, complemented by smaller, lighter sans-serif body text and a distinct monospace font for section numbering.

The palette is dominated by a dark mode aesthetic, featuring black and very dark grey backgrounds with stark white text, accented by a soft lavender/purple and a vibrant red/pink for interactive elements and highlights.

The hero section features a large animated logo (Lottie/video) that transitions out on scroll to reveal static text. Subsequent content sections reveal with a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, and some sections incorporate subtle, looping background animations.
Service offerings are presented in distinct, numbered sections, each with a clear heading, a list of specific services, and a concise descriptive paragraph.

technique_notes: The hero uses a full-bleed video or Lottie animation that plays on load, then on scroll, it animates out to reveal a static, text-based hero. This creates an immediate dynamic impression that transitions to clear messaging.

Content within sections is revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements like headings, text blocks, and images fade up or slide in with a slight delay as their parent section becomes visible in the viewport.

Subtle, looping Lottie animations or short video clips are integrated as background elements in specific sections, adding a layer of dynamic visual interest without distracting from the primary content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, often uppercase headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual anchors, supported by smaller, lighter body text and even smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, input fields, and card corners feature a slight, consistent rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, characterized by generous vertical padding between major sections and within content blocks, contributing to a spacious and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of motion, particularly the dynamic hero animation that transitions on scroll and the integration of subtle Lottie/video background animations throughout, elevates a dark, minimal aesthetic into a highly engaging and premium experience. The numbered service sections also provide a unique structural rhythm.
